source_assessment.habs_status: No same-building HABS record was identified in the initial official-source search; the official National Register nomination is the primary architectural record.
source_assessment.geometry_readiness: The nomination supplies primary dimensions and construction facts, while the existing exact named footprints supply current runtime placement. Roof pitches and detailed elevations remain unresolved.
source_assessment.projection_readiness: Blocked until at least two useful same-building exterior images have item-level creator and rights metadata.

required_before_geometry: Acquire only the National Register pages needed for exterior dimensions, construction, and site relationships.
Record retrieval date, final URL, byte count, and SHA-256 for every acquired artifact.
Hash terrain/public/buildings.json and persist the two resolved named records.
Resolve roof pitches and all opening centers from an official measured source, LiDAR, or calibrated multi-view evidence; mark any remaining value as an explicit estimate.
required_before_projection: Resolve item-level authorship and rights for every selected image.
Confirm each image depicts the Chapel of the Transfiguration rather than the Chapel of the Sacred Heart.
Require at least two useful exterior elevations before invoking an image tool.
Do not use an interior altar-window photograph as facade texture input.
